The '''Sector Chief of Supply''' was a position within the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dargen Io]] was the Chief for the [[Mortex sector/Legends|Mortex sector]].
